subsystem.name: GenericRuntimeObjects
subsystem.responsibility: Cross-cutting runtime objects and helpers that do not belong to a single game system: server-session notification and debug-log append, network-session startup and join-request dispatch, per-frame game-object updates with timer expiry, UI/menu element construction and teardown, season-database object construction by a factory, a profile-name uniqueness manager, and small container/flag helper utilities.

summary: This packet groups 29 generic runtime-object functions. The strongest evidence clusters are: (1) a ServerSessionManager whose single method appends formatted server open/close notifications to an embedded debug-log linked list; (2) a network-session client that starts internet/LAN updates, forwards a network-system pointer at obj+0x1B79C, and sends host join requests; (3) a per-frame GameObject with timer-driven expiry and two flag-gated physics sub-updates; (4) an AnimationFrameTimer accumulator; (5) a UIElement constructor family sharing the sub_48C070 base initializer and the +0x31C/+0x320 data-table fields; (6) a UIMenuScreen family that cleans UI state and rebuilds menu items, including from the module callback table dword_7C73E0; (7) a LinkedListContainer with an embedded singly linked list; (8) a SeasonDatabaseObject constructor family produced by SeasonDatabaseObjectFactory (0x0047F440); (9) a ProfileListManager checking profile-name uniqueness; (10) a UIScreenTextBinding pair reaching screen text through vtable slot +0x1C; and (11) a UIRenderNode destructor. Most class owners are UNKNOWN in the packet; grouping is a GUESS-level proposal grounded in shared base initializers, shared vtables, shared field access at identical base+offset, and shared callees.

classes.name: ServerSessionManager
classes.responsibility: Tracks server track open/close session state and owns an embedded debug-log linked list that accumulates formatted notifications, rendered to the UI resource and optionally written to the engine debug log.

classes.name: NetworkSessionClient
classes.responsibility: Manages a multiplayer network session: starts internet or LAN update paths, forwards the network-system pointer at obj+0x1B79C, and sends host join requests with a reset join flag.

classes.name: GameObject
classes.responsibility: Per-frame updated game object with an optional tracking-list registration, a timer that drives an expiry state transition plus vtable callback, and two flag-gated physics sub-updates; the two active flags are set/cleared by dedicated helpers.

classes.name: AnimationFrameTimer
classes.responsibility: Accumulates per-frame delta time read from a sub-object and advances a 2-frame animation counter when the accumulation exceeds the 2.0 threshold, wrapping at a global limit and firing a vtable callback.

classes.name: UIElement
classes.responsibility: UI menu element constructed through the shared sub_48C070 base initializer with a stored 64-byte-strided or grid-indexed data-table pointer at +0x320, coordinate/index fields at +0x324/+0x328/+0x32C, and a per-type vtable.

classes.name: UIMenuScreen
classes.responsibility: Menu screen object that cleans up UI state via StateCleanupNotification and rebuilds menu items through UIMenuItemCreator, either dispatching a stored command id at +0x174 through formatter paths or iterating the module callback table dword_7C73E0 (including extension-stripped entry names).

classes.name: LinkedListContainer
classes.responsibility: Container holding an embedded singly linked list with head/tail/count/capacity and two-level node allocations; the destructor walks and frees every node's inner and outer data blocks, then the node struct.

classes.name: SeasonDatabaseObject
classes.responsibility: Family of season-database objects constructed by SeasonDatabaseObjectFactory (0x0047F440). Constructors run a shared base/sub-object initializer (sub_4893C0, or sub_48C9F0 for one variant), zero a command/state field at +0x174, set a -1 sentinel at +0x178, optionally write a parameter at +0x17C, and install per-variant vtables.

classes.name: ProfileListManager
classes.responsibility: Manages a receiver's linked list of profile filenames and validates that a candidate profile name does not collide with an existing entry (with a special case for the PlayerNameNever string).

classes.name: UIScreenTextBinding
classes.responsibility: UI binding object that creates or retrieves a screen element through vtable slot +0x1C of the sub-object at this+0x40 (called with element id 44) and then reads or clears its text buffer via UIScreenTextAccessor.

classes.name: UIRenderNode
classes.responsibility: Render/HUD node whose destructor switches between child/base vtables, frees the child node at +0x30 and the owned resource at +0x4, and self-frees when the scalar-deleting flag bit 0 is set.

transitions.name: open
transitions.trigger: opened notification selects the opened verb and sets track_state_timer (+0x2C) to 1.0f

transitions.name: close
transitions.trigger: closed notification selects the closed verb, sets track_state_timer (+0x2C) to -1.0f and clears session_open_flag (+0x29)

transitions.name: consume
transitions.trigger: poller (called from ConditionalChain) reads byte_7CD2A0 non-zero, clears it to 0, and returns consumed (nonzero)

transitions.name: expire
transitions.trigger: expiry_timer (+0x124) falls below 0.0 after countdown; FieldSetterCall(sub-object, 1) marks the state and a vtable callback at offset 172 fires

interfaces.name: UIElementFactory
interfaces.purpose: vtable slot +0x1C (offset 28) of the sub-object at this+0x40, called with element id 44, returns an object whose screen-text buffer is accessed via UIScreenTextAccessor (0x00489920); used for both text initialization and text clearing.

interfaces.name: UIMenuItemBuilder
interfaces.purpose: Menu screens clean UI state via StateCleanupNotification (0x00489CB0) and build items through UIMenuItemCreator (0x00489600), either from command-format dispatch on a stored command id or by iterating the module callback table dword_7C73E0.

interfaces.name: DebugLogSink
interfaces.purpose: Formatted notifications and session events are appended to the engine debug log through StringSplitLoop-gated DebugLogWrite on the dword_8AD25C buffer; writes are suppressed when session type dword_7C569C equals 5.

compatibility_contracts.name: session_debug_log_append
compatibility_contracts.description: ServerSessionManager owns an embedded debug-log linked list at this+0x1B770 (head) / +0x1B774 (tail) / +0x1B778 (first) / +0x1B77C (count). Each entry is a 12-byte node {buffer-wrapper, next, flag byte}; appends allocate the node and a two-word wrapper via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper and render the message via TextLineWrappingAndRendering on dword_7CD204.

compatibility_contracts.name: network_system_pointer_contract
compatibility_contracts.description: The session object behind this+0x0 holds a network-system pointer at +0x1B79C and a join flag at +0x378. A non-null +0x1B79C enables network initialisation (internet mode 1, or LAN across the port range word_7D0FE8..word_7D0FE8+99) and forwarding; the session-entry array at the same offset is indexed bounds-checked when sending join requests.

compatibility_contracts.name: refresh_flag_consume_once
compatibility_contracts.description: Global byte_7CD2A0 is a set-once refresh flag: consumeRefreshFlag, called from ConditionalChain, consumes each set exactly once, clearing it and returning non-zero only on the first read after it was set.

compatibility_contracts.name: debug_log_verbosity_gate
compatibility_contracts.description: Dev-log writes are gated by StringSplitLoop(1, aDDevF119992002_1, selector) against buffer dword_8AD25C and suppressed for session type dword_7C569C == 5 (server session).

compatibility_contracts.name: ui_element_factory_slot
compatibility_contracts.description: UI bindings reach a screen element through vtable slot +0x1C of the sub-object at this+0x40 with argument 44; the returned object exposes its text via UIScreenTextAccessor (0x00489920), which is then initialized or cleared.

compatibility_contracts.name: season_database_factory_contract
compatibility_contracts.description: SeasonDatabaseObjectFactory (0x0047F440) constructs season-database variants whose constructors zero the +0x174 command/state field, set a -1 sentinel at +0x178, optionally write a parameter at +0x17C, and install per-variant vtables.

unresolved: ServerSessionManager is a DERIVED proposal (ABI lead 'Server_Opened_Closed_Notification' + sole caller ConditionalStateDispatch 0x00463760); no CONFIRMED static type exists for it.

The debug-log block at this+0x1B770..0x1B77C is adjacent to the network-system pointer at obj+0x1B79C, but common ownership of the two regions is NOT proven; ServerSessionManager and NetworkSessionClient may or may not be the same session object.
Semantics of ServerSessionManager +0x2C (1084227584 on opened, -1.0f on closed) and +0x29 are inferred as track open/close progress/flag state from surrounding code; not independently confirmed.
Globals flt_59F0B4 (0x0059F0B4) and unk_8AC368 (0x008AC368) are listed for ServerOpenedClosedNotification but do not appear in the raw Hex-Rays body; role unknown.
Which subsystem sets the refresh flag byte_7CD2A0 and what re-evaluation it requests is not established; the single known consumer is ConditionalChain (0x00475570).
ConsumeRefreshFlag, ConditionalStridePointerComputation, and addSaturatedToAllBytes are left ownerless (UnknownObject): no shared-object evidence links them to a class.
ConditionalStridePointerComputation: owner class and the meaning of the stride-872 element array are unknown; whether a2 is an element index or a raw byte multiplier is caller-defined.
addSaturatedToAllBytes iterates 104 elements, matching the engine vehicle slot count, but no packet evidence links the byte array to the vehicle grid.
GameObjectUpdateFrame vtable callbacks at offsets 44, 168 and 172, and the AnimationFrameTimer vtable callback at offset 0xA0, are not resolved to concrete functions in this packet.
Global flt_59E440 is listed for GameObjectUpdateFrame but not referenced in the raw source; its zero-threshold role is unverified.
Global flt_59E800 is listed for AnimationFrameTimer but not referenced in the raw source; the threshold literal 2.0 is raw-source only.

UIElement constructors install distinct vtables (off_59F4F8, off_5A2400, off_5A3A80); whether this is one class with overridden vtables or several classes sharing the sub_48C070 base layout is unresolved.
MenuCommandDispatcher JUMPOUT(0x4675E5) target for cases 451-454 is not statically resolved; the jump table contents at jpt_467506 (0x00467674) and byte_467684 are unknown.

UIMenuScreen grouping is behavioral (shared StateCleanupNotification + UIMenuItemCreator), not a proven shared object layout; MenuCommandDispatcher's +0x174/+0x178 fields are not shown to belong to the same class as the table-iterating builders.

SeasonDatabaseObject constructors install distinct vtables (off_59F718/59F878/59F938/59F9E8/59FA98); the family may represent several concrete subclasses of one base, or a single class with overridden vtables.
Semantics of SeasonDatabaseObject literal values 11/4/55/89, the -1 sentinels at +0x178/+0x34C, and the zeroed +0x344/+0x348/+0x1F4..0x208 block are unknown.
Meaning of dword_7C569C==5 (session type 5) is not defined within this packet; constants 5776/5765 passed to StringSplitLoop are opaque verbosity/guard selectors.
